Native diagnostic helper is a starting witness, not sufficient alone for the final renderer oracle.
obligations.acceptance: Old code must genuinely fail the preserved-pixel assertion; candidate passes for no-write, before-first-object and mid-draw refusal without Direct replay, false receipt or CPU fallback. Full-frame and qualified incremental-damage cases at DPR1/2/4, opaque/transparent/colored backgrounds, translucent overlaps, permanent+active masks. Unchanged failed target bytes have zero tolerance; successful CPU/GPU comparisons use existing frozen AA oracle.

All new staging/metadata charged; no resetting budget manager to hide in-flight resources, no early resource release or omitted flush/fence.
